translation: In the lineage of Jivanji Maharaj, Vitthaldasji, the brother of Vasantdas, established a second gadi (seat of succession) at Hansapura. Thus, in the garden (vadi) at Hansapura, are the tulsi-kyaros (tulsi-plant memorial platforms marking a departed saint's resting place) of the swamis of Hansapura, beginning from Jivanji. Later the gadi was taken from Hansapura to Bodeli, but the site where the gadi once stood remains at Hansapura even today. Thus this place is a sacred site.
